csv_project_name: Consultant for Building Plan Review Services
csv_scope_of_work: The City of Simi Valley invites your firm to submit a Proposal to provide Building Plan Review Services, RFP No. ES 26-01. 1. The Consultant shall perform Service(s) as required by the Building Official. Such plans may be residential, commercial or industrial projects. Service(s) may be in all or any combination of the following disciplines: a. Review of plans for compliance with the currently adopted California Building Code (Title 24, Parts 2 and 2.5) shall include but is not limited to: i. Architectural Review 1. Building construction type, limitation, occupancy, fire resistance rated construction 2. Egress, site requirements, building envelope, dwelling unit requirements ii. Structural Review 1. Foundations, framing and detailing for gravity and lateral design, structural calculations iii. Disabled Access 1. Accessible routes, parking, building access elements and details, public accommodations b. Review of plans for compliance with currently adopted California Electrical Code (Title 24, Part 3) shall include but is not limited to: i. Schematics, single line diagrams, panel schedules and load calculations ii. Fixture approval listings c. Review of plans for compliance with the currently adopted California Mechanical Code (Title 24, Part 4) shall include but is not limited to: i. Piping, duct layouts and sizes for HVAC systems ii. Mechanical fixture/equipment locations, sizes and fixture counts iii. Mechanical design calculations iv. Mechanical equipment approval listings d. Review of plans for compliance with the currently adopted California Plumbing Code (Title 24, Part 5) shall include but is not limited to: i. Piping layouts and isometrics for domestic water, sewer, gas, and drain/waste/vent ii. Plumbing fixture locations and fixture counts iii. Plumbing fixture approval listings iv. Pipe size or hydraulic calculations e. Review of plans for compliance with the currently adopted California Energy Code (Title 24, Part 6) shall include but is not limited to: i. Energy conservation calculations and reports ii. Building envelope components, HVAC systems, electrical/lighting f. Review of plans for compliance with the currently adopted California WoodlandUrban Interface Code (Tittle 24, Part 7) shall include but is not limited to: i. Building materials and systems ii. Access and egress iii. Fire protection plan g. Review of plans for compliance with the currently adopted California Green Building Standards Code (Title 24, Part 11) shall include but is not limited to: i. Water conservation, material conservation, construction waste recycling h. Review of plans for compliance with grading regulations of the California Building Code and California State requirements for Low Impact Development, SWPPP and BMP requirements for grading and drainage projects. 2. Provide Certified Access Specialist (CASp) consultation or inspection to the permitting and plan check services, including reviewing plans and proposed permit scope of work or construction site inspection for compliance with State construction-related accessibility standards by a place of public accommodation with respect to new construction.
csv_disciplines_requested: Architecture Services, Civil Engineering, Inspection Services, Materials Testing, Planning/Master Planning, Pollution Studies, Electrical Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, Structural Engineering, Stormwater

title: Consultant for Building Plan Review Services
short_description: On-call consultant services for municipal building plan review across multiple code disciplines.
project_location: Santa Susana, CA, Ventura County, Southern California, USA
project_scope: On-call building plan review services for residential, commercial, and industrial projects for the City of Simi Valley. Scope includes code compliance review under California Title 24 for architectural, structural, accessibility, electrical, mechanical, plumbing, energy, wildland-urban interface, green building, and grading/drainage requirements, plus CASp consultation and inspection services.
services: Building plan review services as required by the Building Official, including architectural review, structural review and calculations check, disabled access review, electrical, mechanical, plumbing, energy, WUI, CALGreen, grading and drainage compliance review, and Certified Access Specialist consultation/inspection. Contract duration 12 months with 12-month renewal option; up to three contractors may be awarded.
relevance_explanation:
- This is primarily an on-call municipal plan review and code compliance checking service, not design of a specific structure.
- Scope is dominated by architectural, MEP, accessibility, and permitting review rather than structural concept or detailed engineering design.
- No identifiable bridge, long-span roof, special structure, stadium, or complex building project is defined.
- The tender resembles consulting/inspection/framework-style support, which is generally not a target for sbp.
- Although structural review is included, it is only one discipline within broad code checking services.
construction_cost_explanation: No construction budget is stated. The procurement is for consultant plan review services for multiple future projects rather than a defined construction project, so no realistic project construction cost can be derived from the notice.
fee_explanation: No fee or budget is stated in the notice. The contract is an on-call service agreement with up to three contractors, 12-month base period and 12-month renewal option, but without workload, task volume, or compensation details.
references_qualifications: Consultant must be capable of providing building plan review services across multiple disciplines as required by the Building Official, including structural review, accessibility/CASp, electrical, mechanical, plumbing, energy, WUI, CALGreen, and grading/drainage compliance. Specific minimum reference counts or qualification thresholds are not stated in the provided text.
